letter.subject: Request for clarification · VAT return August–October 2026
letter.body_text: In your return you declared output VAT of AED 1,140,000 in Box 1b (Dubai) and AED 288,800 in Box 1a (Abu Dhabi). Your electronic invoices show AED 1,626,200 and AED 214,600. The net difference of AED 412,000 relates to 38 tax invoices issued in October 2026 by your Dubai establishment (list attached). Please, within 20 business days, explain the difference and provide supporting documents, or submit a Voluntary Disclosure.

letter.subject: Reply to CDP-VAT-2026-1187
letter.body_text: The difference of AED 486,200 in Dubai consists of two parts. AED 412,000 relates to 34 invoices of October 2026 recorded in November by mistake; we have submitted a Voluntary Disclosure. AED 74,200 relates to 4 invoices of our Dubai establishment reported under Abu Dhabi; the same Voluntary Disclosure moves them to Box 1b.

letter.subject: Case closed · CDP-VAT-2026-1187
letter.body_text: Your Voluntary Disclosure for August–October 2026 has been reconciled with your electronic invoices and accepted. The case is closed.

letter.subject: VAT refund request · partial approval and request for documents
letter.body_text: Your VAT refund request of AED 284,600 for August–October 2026 has been reviewed. AED 53,600 is approved. For the remaining AED 231,000, please provide within 10 business days tax invoices for input VAT of AED 184,200 not supported by electronic invoices, and evidence of payment of VAT of AED 46,800 to Bright Line General Trading LLC (14 invoices).

letter.subject: Reply to CDP-REF-2026-0219
letter.body_text: Please find attached 6 tax invoices for input VAT of AED 150,000 from suppliers that do not yet issue electronic invoices, and 14 bank payment confirmations for VAT of AED 46,800 paid to Bright Line General Trading LLC. AED 34,200 relates to expenses without tax invoices; we have corrected it by a Voluntary Disclosure.

letter.subject: VAT refund decision
letter.body_text: A further refund of AED 150,000 is approved, AED 203,600 in total. AED 34,200 is not approved, as it is not supported by tax invoices and has been corrected by your Voluntary Disclosure. AED 46,800 is on hold pending verification of the supplier Bright Line General Trading LLC.
